# Mentions, saved views and attention

A mention is one post matched to one keyword, with its `post`, its `author`, the `keyword` and the classifier's `classification` (relevance 0 to 100, relevant from 40 up, sentiment and intents). `status` is the user's triage: `open`, `ignored` or `done`. The user can overrule the classifier with `relevant` or `sentiment`, which moves the mention in or out of the relevant feed and the digests without changing what was billed. Search 20 to 50 at a time; don't page through the whole feed unprompted. Saved views store a set of filters; attention lists spikes and failing channels.

Base URL `https://api.rumoro.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $RUMORO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. Each endpoint names its `rumoro` CLI command for when the CLI is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /v1/mentions/{id}`: Get a mention

Fetches one mention by id, with the same fields the list returns. An id from another workspace gets a 404.

CLI: `rumoro mentions:get`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | Mention id (mm_...). |

Answers `200` with `id`, `status`, `relevant`, `delivered`, `priority`, `keyword`, `post`, `author`, `review`, `classification`, `triage`, `createdAt`: The mention.

### `PATCH /v1/mentions/{id}`: Update a mention

The only way to change a mention. Set status to ignored or done when it is handled, or back to open. You can also assign it to a member, snooze it out of the feed, add a note for your team, or correct the classifier. `relevant` true or false is your judgment, which sets relevance to 100 or 0 for every list, filter, digest and report. `sentiment` replaces the label. Null removes your correction and brings back the classifier's value. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Delivery and billing are never affected.

CLI: `rumoro mentions:update`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | Mention id (mm_...). |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `open`, `ignored`, `done` |  | ignored or done marks it handled, and open reopens it. |
| `assigneeId` | string or null |  | The user id of a workspace member, or null to remove the assignment. |
| `snoozedUntil` | string |  | Hides the mention from the feed until this time, given as ISO 8601 or epoch ms. Send null to bring it back now. |
| `note` | string or null |  | A note for your team. Null or an empty string removes it. |
| `relevant` | boolean or null |  | Set it to override the classifier, or null to restore the classifier's score. true means relevance 100, and a filtered mention joins the relevant feed. false means 0, and it leaves. Billing is unaffected. While the mention is still being classified this returns 409 classification_pending. |
| `sentiment` | `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` or null |  | The sentiment you choose. Null removes it and brings back the classifier's. |

Answers `200` with `id`, `status`, `relevant`, `delivered`, `priority`, `keyword`, `post`, `author`, `review`, `classification`, `triage`, `createdAt`: The updated mention.

### `GET /v1/mentions`: List mentions

Lists your keywords' mentions with filters and paging. Each mention pairs one post with one keyword. Latest match first by default, or sort=priority to rank the last 30 days by attention score. For the next page, send nextCursor and keep the filters and sort. alertId applies an alert's filter, giving what that alert would send. anyOf adds OR groups as URL-encoded JSON, at least one of which must match along with every other filter.

CLI: `rumoro mentions:search`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keywordId` | query | string |  | Only this keyword's matches. |
| `platform` | query | `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Only this platform's posts. |
| `status` | query | `open`, `ignored`, `done` |  | Keeps mentions with this status only. Leave it out for all statuses. |
| `relevant` | query | boolean |  | true keeps mentions the classifier scored relevant. false keeps the others, including unscored ones. |
| `sentiment` | query | `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` |  | Keeps mentions with this sentiment only. |
| `intent` | query | string |  | Returns only mentions with this tag. One of bug_report, buy_intent, churn_intent, comparison, complaint, event, feedback, hiring, industry_insight, launch, praise, pricing, promotional, question and testimonial. |
| `automated` | query | boolean |  | true keeps mentions that look machine-made, such as bot accounts, scheduled or template posts and AI-written text. false keeps the others, including mentions scored before this flag existed. Leave it out for all. |
| `personId` | query | string |  | Keeps mentions by this person (an id from /v1/people), including merged accounts. Turns on includeMuted. |
| `includeMuted` | query | boolean |  | true also returns mentions by muted people, which are hidden by default. |
| `assigneeId` | query | string |  | Member user id. Returns only mentions assigned to them. |
| `snoozed` | query | boolean |  | true shows only snoozed mentions, which are otherwise hidden until they wake. |
| `excludeAuthors` | query | string[] or null |  | Leaves out these authors, given as display names, handles or profile links. Repeat the parameter or send one value with commas. |
| `minRelevance` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps mentions with this relevance score or higher. Unscored mentions are left out. |
| `minConfidence` | query | number or null |  | Minimum classifier confidence, 0 to 1. Mentions with no confidence are dropped. |
| `minFollowers` | query | integer or null |  | Sends only posts by authors with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out. |
| `maxFollowers` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps posts by authors with this many followers or fewer. Unknown counts are left out. |
| `isReply` | query | boolean |  | true keeps replies and comments, meaning posts that answer another post. false keeps posts that are not replies. Leave it out for both. |
| `alertId` | query | string |  | Adds an alert rule's filter (an id from GET /v1/alerts) to the other filters. You get the mentions the rule would send, useful for a preview or an export in feed form. An unknown id returns 404. |
| `viewId` | query | string |  | Adds a saved view's filter (an id from GET /v1/views) to the other filters, with every condition joined by AND. You get exactly what the view shows. An unknown id returns 404. |
| `keywordKinds` | query | list of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic` |  | Keeps matches of keywords of these kinds only (brand, competitor, topic). Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `tags` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps authors your workspace gave one of these tags, matched exactly and by case. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `linkHosts` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps posts that link to one of these hosts or its subdomains, so slack.com also matches api.slack.com. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `platforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps posts from these platforms only. |
| `notPlatforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Platforms to exclude. |
| `keywordIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps matches of these keywords only. |
| `groupIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps matches of keywords in these groups only (grp_...). Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `notGroupIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Hides matches from keywords that belong to these groups. |
| `notKeywordIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keyword ids to exclude. |
| `sentiments` | query | list of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` |  | Keeps mentions with these sentiments only. |
| `notSentiments` | query | list of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` |  | Leaves out these sentiments. Mentions not scored yet are kept. |
| `intents` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps mentions tagged with one of these intents or topics. |
| `notIntents` | query | string[] or null |  | Intent or topic tags to exclude. |
| `notLinkHosts` | query | string[] or null |  | Leaves out posts that link to these hosts or their subdomains. |
| `notTags` | query | string[] or null |  | Leaves out authors your workspace gave one of these tags. |
| `languages` | query | string[] |  | Sends only posts in these languages, as ISO 639-1 codes such as en, es or de. Posts with an unknown language are left out. |
| `notLanguages` | query | string[] |  | Leaves out posts in these languages. Posts with an unknown language are kept. |
| `ratings` | query | integer[] |  | Keeps reviews with one of these star ratings, from 1 to 5. Use ratings=1,2 for the unhappy ones. Posts that are not reviews are left out. |
| `notRatings` | query | integer[] |  | Star ratings (1 to 5) to hide, such as notRatings=5. Other posts are unaffected. |
| `minLikes` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps posts with this many likes (upvotes, reactions) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a like count are left out. |
| `minReposts` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps posts with this many reposts (shares, retweets) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a repost count are left out. |
| `minReplies` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps posts with this many replies (comments) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a reply count are left out. |
| `minQuotes` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps posts with this many quotes or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a quote count are left out. |
| `minViews` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps posts with this many views (plays) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a view count are left out. |
| `minBookmarks` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps posts with this many bookmarks (saves) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a bookmark count are left out. |
| `anyOf` | query | string |  | Groups of conditions joined by OR, as URL-encoded JSON. For example [{"platforms":["github"],"intents":["bug_report"]},{"sentiments":["negative"]}] means "bug reports on GitHub, or anything negative". A group uses the fields of a view filter, where a list matches any value, a not list matches none, and all conditions are joined by AND. A mention passes when one group matches, and the other filters here still apply. Send 1 to 10 groups, none empty and none nested. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Searches post text and author names. |
| `since` | query | string |  | Keeps posts published at this time or later, as ISO 8601 or epoch ms. |
| `until` | query | string |  | Keeps posts published at this time or earlier, as ISO 8601 or epoch ms. |
| `sort` | query | `newest`, `priority` |  | newest orders by match time, latest first. priority orders by attention score, highest first, and only covers the past 30 days of matches. Older ones are still available with newest. A cursor only works with the sort it came from. |
| `cursor` | query | string |  | Pass the previous page's nextCursor, with the same filters and sort. |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | How many to return, from 1 to 100. |

Answers `200` with `data`, `nextCursor`: A page of mentions, sorted as requested.

### `GET /v1/mentions/export.csv`: Export mentions as CSV

Returns as CSV the mentions GET /v1/mentions lists for the same filters. Rows are ordered by match time, latest first, which is the order they reached your feed and can differ from the post date. The columns are id, published_at, platform, keyword, author, author_url, author_followers, relevance, sentiment, intents (separated by |), language, confidence, status, relevant, delivered, url, links (separated by |), text (the first 1,000 characters), group, group_external_id, rating and app_id (reviews only), and title and image_url (on platforms that have them). The file holds at most 10,000 rows, and the X-Mentions-Truncated header tells you when rows were cut. Each workspace can export 6 times a minute, and a 429 includes Retry-After.

### `GET /v1/mentions/export.json`: Export mentions as JSON

Returns in one response the mentions GET /v1/mentions lists for the same filters, latest match first, which is the order they reached your feed. Each row is the full Mention object from the list, text included. At most 10,000 mentions are returned, and `truncated` tells you when some were cut. It shares the CSV export's limit of 6 exports a minute per workspace, in either format, and a 429 includes Retry-After.

### `GET /v1/views`: List views

Lists the saved views in creation order. A view stores a mention filter under a name. GET /v1/mentions and the exports take its id as `viewId` and return what the view shows.

CLI: `rumoro views:list`

Answers `200` with `data`: The workspace's views.

### `POST /v1/views`: Create a view

Saves a named mention filter. It uses the same fields as GET /v1/mentions, where a list matches any value, a `not` list matches none, and all conditions are joined by AND. `anyOf` adds groups of such conditions, at least one of which must match. An empty filter shows all mentions. Nothing is stored ahead of time, so a view shows whatever matches when you read it.

CLI: `rumoro views:create`

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | Must be unique in the workspace, ignoring case. |
| `description` | string |  | The view's purpose, shown below its name. |
| `filter` | object |  | The view's filter. Empty means all mentions. |
| `filter.q` | string |  | Searches post text and author names. |
| `filter.keywordIds` | string[] |  | Keeps matches of these keywords only. |
| `filter.notKeywordIds` | string[] |  | Keyword ids to exclude. |
| `filter.keywordKinds` | list of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic` |  | Keyword kinds to keep, out of brand, competitor and topic. |
| `filter.groupIds` | string[] |  | Limits to keywords from these groups (grp_...). |
| `filter.notGroupIds` | string[] |  | Hides matches from keywords that belong to these groups. |
| `filter.platforms` | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps posts from these platforms only. |
| `filter.notPlatforms` | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Platforms to exclude. |
| `filter.status` | `open`, `ignored`, `done` |  | Keeps mentions with this status only (open, ignored or done). |
| `filter.relevant` | boolean |  | Filter on the classifier's verdict. true keeps relevant mentions, false the rest. |
| `filter.minRelevance` | integer |  | Minimum relevance score a mention needs. |
| `filter.minConfidence` | number |  | Keeps mentions whose classifier confidence is this value or higher. |
| `filter.sentiments` | list of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` |  | Keeps mentions with these sentiments only. |
| `filter.notSentiments` | list of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` |  | Hides these sentiments. Unscored mentions stay. |
| `filter.intents` | string[] |  | Keeps mentions tagged with one of these intents or topics. |
| `filter.notIntents` | string[] |  | Hides mentions with these tags. |
| `filter.automated` | boolean |  | true keeps posts that look machine-made. false keeps the others. |
| `filter.languages` | string[] |  | Keeps posts in these languages only, as ISO 639-1 codes. |
| `filter.notLanguages` | string[] |  | Leaves out posts in these languages. Posts with an unknown language are kept. |
| `filter.tags` | string[] |  | Keeps authors your workspace gave one of these tags. |
| `filter.notTags` | string[] |  | Leaves out authors with one of these tags. |
| `filter.linkHosts` | string[] |  | Keeps posts that link to one of these hosts or its subdomains. |
| `filter.notLinkHosts` | string[] |  | Leaves out posts that link to these hosts. |
| `filter.minFollowers` | integer |  | Keeps authors with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out. |
| `filter.maxFollowers` | integer |  | Keeps authors with this many followers or fewer. Unknown counts are left out. |
| `filter.isReply` | boolean |  | true keeps replies and comments. false keeps posts that are not replies. |
| `filter.excludeAuthors` | string[] |  | Leaves out these authors, given as display names, handles or profile links. |
| `filter.ratings` | integer[] |  | Keeps reviews with one of these star ratings. Posts that are not reviews are left out. |
| `filter.notRatings` | integer[] |  | Hides reviews with these star ratings. Other posts are not affected. |
| `filter.minLikes` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many likes (upvotes, reactions) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a like count are left out. |
| `filter.minReposts` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many reposts (shares, retweets) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a repost count are left out. |
| `filter.minReplies` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many replies (comments) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a reply count are left out. |
| `filter.minQuotes` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many quotes or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a quote count are left out. |
| `filter.minViews` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many views (plays) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a view count are left out. |
| `filter.minBookmarks` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many bookmarks (saves) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a bookmark count are left out. |
| `filter.anyOf` | object[] |  | Up to 10 OR'd groups (at least 1). A mention must meet every condition of some group, plus all other conditions, so the filter reads (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). Groups take view filter fields (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists and so on) but no nested anyOf. |

Answers `201` with `id`, `name`, `description`, `filter`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`: The new view.

### `GET /v1/views/{id}`: Get a view

Returns one saved view and its filter. Pass its id as `viewId` to list or export the mentions it shows.

CLI: `rumoro views:get`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The view's id (vw_...). |

Answers `200` with `id`, `name`, `description`, `filter`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`: The requested view.

### `DELETE /v1/views/{id}`: Delete a view

Deletes the view. Its mentions are unchanged.

CLI: `rumoro views:delete`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The view's id (vw_...). |

Answers `204`: Done.

### `GET /v1/attention`: List attention items

Lists items that need a person, latest first. Kinds are mention.spike (a keyword's mentions jumped in the last hour), sentiment.negative_spike (its 24-hour negative share jumped), keyword.noisy (it turned noisy) and channel.failing (a channel's recent sends all failed). Checks run hourly. Items open when the condition starts and resolve when it ends. Open items are the default, and `status=all` adds the history. Opening an item also sends an account event of the same name to subscribed webhook, Slack, email and Telegram channels.

CLI: `rumoro attention:list`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | query | `open`, `resolved`, `dismissed`, `all` |  | Which items to list. Defaults to open. |
| `kind` | query | string |  | Filters by kind. Send a comma-separated list such as mention.spike,keyword.noisy. |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | How many items to return, latest first. 50 by default and 100 at most. |
| `cursor` | query | string |  | Pass the previous page's nextCursor. |

Answers `200` with `data`, `nextCursor`: The attention items.

### `POST /v1/attention/{id}/dismiss`: Dismiss an attention item

Dismisses an item. It leaves the open list and stays away while its condition lasts. After the condition ends, a new episode can open a new item. Calling it twice has the same effect as once.

CLI: `rumoro attention:dismiss`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The attention item's id (att_...). |

Answers `200` with `id`, `kind`, `status`, `subject`, `title`, `openedAt`, `resolvedAt`, `dismissedAt`, `data`: The item, now dismissed.
